notes: Never impute missing realized net return as zero or as a loss.
Primary factor analysis includes only rows with 納入報酬=True, 進場有效=True, 出場有效=True, and non-missing 實際淨報酬.
Secondary factor analysis includes observed net returns with valid entry/exit regardless of 納入報酬; it is not presented as strategy PnL.
Factor associations are calculated separately by H, cost scenario and trade mode; repeated scenarios are not pooled into one pseudo-independent sample.
BH-FDR is applied across all reported factor-by-cohort-by-stratum Spearman tests.
H=3 and H=10 have no exact v4.70.1 forward-label counterpart; analysis of their existing v2.51 realized return is kept separate from v4.70.1 labels.
This is an association and diagnostic study, not causal attribution, a retrained model, or a live trading recommendation.
